tm.「海の男コンテストが 始まる直前で中止になって\n いい海の男たちを 見られなか: The Mighty Man Contest was cancelled just before it started and I missed the fine men, but seeing Jasper made up for it!
tm.「ドックに すっごく大きくて派手な船があるの！\n 聞いた話によれば 持ち主は\: There's a huge, flashy ship at the dock! I heard the owner is the famous entertainer Sylvando!
tm.「さすが 華やかなスターが持ってる船は\n 持ち主と同じように ゴージャスなのね: As expected, a ship owned by a glamorous star is as gorgeous as its owner!
tm.「ねえ ねえ！\n 今さっき そこにいた 背の高い人……\n もしかして あの旅: Hey, hey! That tall person who was just here... was that the entertainer Sylvando?!
tm.「なーんだ オーラが ただ者じゃないと\n 思ったんだけど ちがったんだ。\n: Oh, so not. I thought that aura was no ordinary one, but I was wrong. I thought it was the real thing.
tm.「わっ 私のカン当たってたわ！ すごーい！\n やっぱり あんなゴージャスな船の: Wow, my hunch was right! Amazing! Of course the owner of such a gorgeous ship would be that dazzling!
tm.「……どこかで 見たことある気がしたんだけど\n もしかして 有名人だったりしな: ...I feel like I've seen you somewhere. Are you a celebrity, by any chance?

tm.「あら 有名な話なのに 知らないの？\n 昔 ユグノアという大国があってね。\n: Oh, you haven't? It's quite famous. There was once a great country called Dundrasil, and the Darkspawn is said to be why it fell.
tm.「まあ 有名ですものね。\n その悪魔の子が デルカダール王国に現れて\n 今は: Well, it is famous. That Darkspawn appeared in Heliodor and is now on the run.
tm.「あの将軍グレイグさまや ホメロスさままで\n 悪魔の子を追っているらしいわよ。: Even Generals Hendrik and Jasper are chasing the Darkspawn. He must be a terribly dangerous criminal.
tm.「あっ 悪魔の子！\n あなたの罪は 神も ごぞんじです！\n 観念して ホメロ: Ah, the Darkspawn! The gods know your sin! Resign yourself and go to General Jasper!
tm.「例の大騒動の時 悪魔の子に会ったのよ。\n でも とても こわかったから\n: I met the Darkspawn during that big commotion. But I was so scared I don't remember his face at all...
tm.「ホメロス将軍からも 逃げおおせるなんて\n 悪魔の子は 運がいいわね。\n 今: Escaping even General Jasper, the Darkspawn is lucky. Where could he be fleeing now...
tm.「まあ カウデルさんの歌声ったら\n なんて 安らぐのかしら……。\n まるで: Oh, Cawdel's singing is so soothing... It feels like being rocked on the waves.
tm.「……けれど 海の男コンテスト前回優勝者\n レアルさんの たくましい筋肉も ス: ...But last year's champion Real's strong muscles are lovely too, and I can't decide whom to cheer for in the contest!
tm.「……え？ もしかして あなた\n 海の男コンテストを 知らないの？: ...Hm? You don't know about the Mighty Man Contest?
tm.「海の男コンテストとはね……\n 世界各地から イイ男が集まる お祭りなのよ！\: The Mighty Man Contest is a festival where fine men gather from all over the world! I can't wait!
tm.「あら もしかして 参加者だったかしら？\n ……たしかに あなたも なかなかの: Oh, were you a contestant? ...You are rather handsome. If you enter, I'll cheer for you.
tm.「もしかして あなた……\n 海の男コンテストを 知らないの？: Could it be you... don't know the Mighty Man Contest?
tm.「海で 美しい声が聞こえてくるっていう\n ウワサもあるけど カウデルさんの歌み: There are rumors of a beautiful voice at sea, but it must be as pleasant to the ears as Cawdel's song.
tm.「釣りの極意ってモンはな……\n どんなことがあっても あわてず 騒がず\n 獲: The secret of fishing is... no matter what, stay calm and don't panic. Keep waiting until the catch bites.
tm.「だから これから どんなことがあっても\n 俺は しんぼう強く 獲物を待ち続け: So whatever happens, I'll patiently wait for my catch. ...Not that I've caught anything.
tm.「おや アンタ 逃げなくても大丈夫なのかい。\n この先のステージでは ホメロス: Oh, you needn't flee? On the stage ahead, General Jasper is searching for the Darkspawn and the mood is tense.
tm.「……えっ 俺は逃げなくても いいのかって？\n 何が起ころうと 平常心で 待ち: ...What, I needn't run? Whatever happens, stay composed and keep waiting. That's the secret of fishing.
tm.「……そう 決して ボーっとしてて\n 逃げおくれたワケじゃないんだ……ブルルッ: ...Right, I'm not just spacing out and missing my chance to flee... *shiver*
tm.「おや 旅の方 見学かい？\n ここでは この町で売るケーキだけでなく\n 世界: Oh, traveler, here to look around? We make cakes here, not just for sale in town but to ship to the world.

tm.「おや 旅の方 見学かい？\n 悪いけど もう工房は 閉めるところだよ。\n 見: Oh, traveler, here to look around? Sorry, but we're closing the workshop. Come back tomorrow.
tm.「コンテストのために 遠い国から来た人たちが\n ここのケーキを 気に入ってくれ: People who came from far countries for the contest liked our cakes. We got loads of orders!
tm.「おかげさまで ケーキ作りで 大忙しさ。\n 祭りに参加したかったけど 多くのお: Cake-making has me swamped. I wanted to join the festival, but I'd rather have many customers taste our cakes.

tm.「いらっしゃいませ。\n ここは ダーハルーネのケーキ屋よ。\n ほっぺが落ちる: Welcome. This is Gondolia's cake shop. They say it's so delicious your cheeks will fall off.
tm.「……そうそう よく 間違われるんだけど\n 道具屋さんなら このお店の１階にあ: Oh yes, people often mix this up, but the item shop is on this building's first floor. Take the stairs right there down.

tm.「あの人 グロッタという町から来たそうだけど\n なんでも 太陽の光がささない町: He said he's from a town called Grotto, where sunlight doesn't reach. I can't imagine what kind of town it is.
tm.「ねえ アナタ 海の暴れん坊\n クラーゴンのことを 知ってる？: Hey, do you know about Krakengon, the brute of the sea?
tm.「あら 知らないの？\n ……私も 海の男のダーリンから聞いたんだけど\n この: Oh, you don't? I heard it from my sailor darling. It's a huge monster ravaging the seas around here.
tm.「最近は 前にも増して 凶暴化してるって話よ。\n 海の男たちからも おそれられ: Lately it's been even more vicious than before. Even sailors fear it, so be very careful if you go out to sea.
tm.「海を荒らすって 有名だし\n 旅の方なら 当然 知ってるわよね。\n 最近は: It's famous for ravaging the seas, so naturally a traveler knows. Lately it's been even more vicious than before.
tm.「今日は ダーリンのお店の手伝いをしてるの！\n ふたりの愛の結晶を たくさん売: Today I'm helping at my darling's stall! We'll sell lots of our love's fruits and take a long trip together!
tm.「海の男コンテストは 中止になっちゃったけど\n ダーリンと一緒に出した露店は: The Mighty Man Contest was cancelled, but the stall I ran with my darling was a success!
tm.「お金も そこそこ貯まったし\n ソルティコの町へ バカンスに行って\n ぜいた: We've saved a decent sum, so I want to vacation in Puerto Valor and splurge to my heart's content!
tm.「今度 この町では 大きなお祭りが あってね。\n 大通りでは ギッシリと 露店: A big festival is coming to this town. Stalls will pack the main street. I don't think it hurts to come see it.
tm.「あそこのふたり組…… 明らかに この町では\n 見かけないカオだけど 一体 何: Those two over there... I clearly haven't seen them in this town. Who are they? Will they enter the contest?
tm.「おーい ハニー！ オレだ～っ！\n 悪魔の子じゃないよ～っ！ 愛してる！\n: Hey, honey! It's me! Not the Darkspawn! I love you! So please open the door!
tm.「おや 旅の方かい。もしも 海の男コンテストを\n 見にきたのなら 残念だったな: Oh, traveler. If you came to see the Mighty Man Contest, too bad. This year's festival got cancelled.
tm.「なんと あのウワサの悪魔の子が 現れてな。\n デルカダールの将軍 ホメロスさ: The rumored Darkspawn showed up, then General Jasper of Heliodor too. It was total chaos!
tm.「まったく 最近は どうなってやがるんだ？\n 悪魔の子が現れたり 魔物の群れが: What's going on lately? The Darkspawn shows up, then a pack of monsters... It's like this town is cursed.
tm.「も～ おにーたん どこに かくれたのかな？\n ちっとも 見つけられないよ～。: Aww, where did Big Brother hide? I can't find him at all. I wanna hide too!

tm.「ん？ なぜ こんな所に 店を出してるか？\n ……ホッホッ そんなもん 決まっ: Hm? Why am I set up in a place like this? ...Ho ho, obviously, I lost the stall-spot race!

tm.「というワケで 伝説の秘宝 けんじゃの石は\n わしの船と一緒に この海の どこ: And so the legendary treasure, the sage's stone, sleeps quietly somewhere in this sea along with my ship.
